ownStation.rule: the approved plan (visA) leaves the viewer's own station out of the viewer's view, and so does this sheet

featureTest.rule: Every step-2 mask edge either clearly overlaps a feature in the test, covering it with at least 15 px to spare, or clears it by at least 15 px (square pixels): no part of the feature lies within 15 px of a mask edge. A named exception, for the Lead's decision, passes only where every such part lies in its zone. The features not in the test are measured and reported.
